name: ant-colony-desktop-pet
description: 蚁群桌面宠物：把桌面变成一张会寻找食物的蚁群地图。

scripts.pack:win:dir: npm run build:renderer && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --dir --publish never
scripts.dist:win: npm run build:renderer && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:win:portable: npm run build:renderer && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win portable --x64 --publish never
